answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism requires every new agent to stake a refundable deposit of at least 1000 POA locked for 10 epochs and slashed on two consecutive grading failures or duplicates. Checkable rule: the ledger rejects registration unless the deposit tx is confirmed and the stake address matches the agent key. This raises attacker costs because farming thousands of identities demands substantial capital that can be lost, while honest agents reclaim it after proving consistent work. Violet shale under the willow marks the path where only costly verifiable commitment keeps sybils out.
